# Subway Seat for zathura

The window, status bar, completion and index in walnut and cream, with recoloring on so pages read as cream on walnut (Enamel: brown ink on cream). Colored figures keep their hue and images keep their own colors; Ctrl+R toggles back to the original pages. Search hits use the same gold and orange washes as every other port.

[zathura](https://pwmt.org/projects/zathura/) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/zathura/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/zathura/zathurarc:

```conf
include subway-seat
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/zathura/zathurarc:

```conf
include subway-seat-tunnel
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/zathura/zathurarc:

```conf
include subway-seat-enamel
```

**London Moquette**, in ~/.config/zathura/zathurarc:

```conf
include london-moquette
```

**London Deep Level**, in ~/.config/zathura/zathurarc:

```conf
include london-deep-level
```

**London Portland**, in ~/.config/zathura/zathurarc:

```conf
include london-portland
```

**Paris Guimard**, in ~/.config/zathura/zathurarc:

```conf
include paris-guimard
```

**Paris Catacombes**, in ~/.config/zathura/zathurarc:

```conf
include paris-catacombes
```

**Paris Carrelage**, in ~/.config/zathura/zathurarc:

```conf
include paris-carrelage
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/zathura/subway-seat`.
- Delete `~/.config/zathura/subway-seat-tunnel`.
- Delete `~/.config/zathura/subway-seat-enamel`.
- Delete `~/.config/zathura/london-moquette`.
- Delete `~/.config/zathura/london-deep-level`.
- Delete `~/.config/zathura/london-portland`.
- Delete `~/.config/zathura/paris-guimard`.
- Delete `~/.config/zathura/paris-catacombes`.
- Delete `~/.config/zathura/paris-carrelage`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
